results.description:
Watch MLB, NBA, NHL, NASCAR, NCAA college football, NCAA college basketball, WNBA, NFL, MLS soccer, F1 racing, the 2026 FIFA World Cup, UEFA Champions League, LaLiga, Bundesliga and more, all live. Plus, stream acclaimed TV series, live news and award-winning movies. Enjoy Unlimited Cloud DVR and dedicated sports pages to watch what you want, when you want.

350+ LIVE TV CHANNELS
Fubo has over 350 TV channels and is the only way to get every Nielsen-rated sports channel without cable. Fubo features ABC, CBS, FOX, ESPN, CBS Sports Network, FS1, NFL Network, NFL RedZone, NBA TV, MLB Network, MLB.TV, NHL Network, beIN SPORTS, SEC Network, ACC Network, Big Ten Network, Willow TV, Tennis Channel, regional sports networks for most local markets.

STREAMING LEADER IN BASEBALL 
Fubo has the most MLB you can watch without cable — more than YouTubeTV or any other streaming provider. Stream MLB Network, FOX and ESPN plus local team coverage on Space City Home Network, YES Network, NESN, MASN, all included in your base plan. (Regional restrictions apply.) You can also watch out-of-market games with MLB.TV.  

ESPN UNLIMITED INCLUDED FREE
Most Fubo plans include access to ESPN+/ESPN Unlimited at no extra cost. This means you get unlimited access to every out-of-market hockey game with NHL Power Play, NCAA sports, LaLiga, PGA Tour golf, tennis, Bundesliga soccer and much more. 

FOX ONE INCLUDED FREE
Most Fubo plans include access to FOX One at no extra cost! FOX One brings together all your favorite FOX channels, includingFOX News, FOX Sports, FOX Weather, FS1, FS2, FOX Business, FOX Deportes, Big Ten Network (BTN), local FOX stations, and FOX Network — all in one place.

THE MOST LOCAL SPORTS FOR THE LOWEST PRICE
With YES Network, MSG Network, NESN, MASN, Marquee Sports Network, Chicago Sports Network, Altitude Sports, Space City Home Network and other regional sports networks, Fubo offers access to most live games and dedicated local coverage of MLB, NBA and NHL teams all season long. (Subject to local availability and blackout restrictions.)

EXTENSIVE LIVE SPORTS COVERAGE & MAJOR EVENTS
NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAA, PGA golf, WNBA, NASCAR, F1… you name it, we got it. That's over 50,000 live pro and college events — regional to international, including NFL games, MLB games, NBA Finals, NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs, FIFA World Cup, U.S. Open, Triple Crown, Olympics, tennis grand slams, ICC Cricket World Cup and more. Stream it all live.

LIVE SOCCER GAMES FROM AROUND THE WORLD
Watch the 2026 FIFA World Cup, UEFA Champions League, Europa League, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Liga MX, MLS and more. Catch El Clásico between Real Madrid and Barcelona and other matches from LaLiga on ESPN Deportes. 

TV SHOWS & MOVIES, LIVE & ON DEMAND
Fubo has over 10,000 hours of on-demand TV shows and movies. So you can catch up on acclaimed series and popular movies on ABC, CBS, FOX, Comedy Central, Ion Television, Hallmark Channel, TV Land, MTV, Disney Channel, Nickelodeon, Bravo, Paramount + with SHOWTIME, FX, Paramount Network, and more.

NEVER MISS ANOTHER PLAY
Unlimited Cloud DVR space is included with every account. Record anything, start watching on one device and finish on any other. Forgot to set the record options? No problem. You can replay nearly any game, show or movie that aired in the last 3 days with 72-hour Lookback.

WATCHING LIVE STREAMS
To watch any streaming service, including Fubo, YouTube TV, ESPN+, Sling TV, Peacock, Paramount+, Netflix, HBO Max, Pluto TV or Amazon Prime Video, a high-speed connection is required. This could be through a mobile data plan or internet provider like Comcast Xfinity or Spectrum. 

Terms of Service: https://www.fubo.tv/documents/terms-of-service
Privacy policy: https://www.fubo.tv/documents/privacy-policy
This app features Nielsen's proprietary measurement software which will allow you to contribute to market research like Nielsen's TV Ratings. Please see nielsen.com/digitalprivacy for more information.
